text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the dance studio, a familiar 
horse girl caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yahoo, Tarumae♪ How's live practice going?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
*phew*... Still not good enough. I have to 
polish it properly before the real 
performance.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Hrmm~? Tarumae, doesn't your voice 
sound a bit off?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Eh? N-No... it's nothing like that. Right, 
time for the next part—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah, your movements are off too. You 
usually nail them with way more sharpness.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. She might be feelin' a wee bit of 
exhaustion creepin' in.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Acute-san. So you see it too, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Her footwork looks a mite unsteady too. 
Seems she can't keep her focus for long 
either.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae, if fatigue is building up, let's 
take a break already! We still have three 
days until the weekend performance, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...It's not 'still.' There are *only* 
three days left. I don't want to 
disappoint the audience.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...When your qi is disturbed, it's easy to 
fall ill. If your condition gets seriously 
worse now, you might not even be able to 
perform at all...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Tarumae-chan has such a strong sense of 
responsibility. Sometimes to the point of 
overdoing it.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
She works so hard for her fans. ...Tarumae 
is amazing.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But I want everyone I see to smile, too. 
And that includes Tarumae. So—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Maybe there's something you 
and I can do to help, Rickey-chan.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ta~rumae~!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ta-da! Look what I brought for you today!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: A-A bouquet...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Depending on their color, flowers have the 
power to bring various effects to a whole 
space and harmonize the qi of the area!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
White is for purification, and red is for 
vitality! Oh, besides this, I also brought 
green for boosting health and orange for 
relaxation!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Rickey...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Even if we told you to stop, you wouldn't 
anyway. So instead, we'll back you up by 
keeping your qi nicely aligned♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Your throat didn't seem to be in great 
shape either, so I made some daikon radish 
candy for you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It works reeeally well for a sore throat, 
so just eat this and get plenty of rest, 
and you'll be fine.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
You two... Hehe, I really can't beat you 
guys.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae is holding a concert in 
town, prompting me to stop and watch.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for coming today! For the 
final song, as a special treat, I'll be 
performing together with... my precious 
friends!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If it weren't for the two of you 
supporting me, today might not have gone 
this well. Thank you so much, both of you!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Please enjoy my... our ultimate stage 
until the very end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she was able to deliver a 
flawless, peerless performance.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Cheer with me! Next up is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A live concert is taking place in town, 
causing me to stop. The one singing is 
Hokko Tarumae. And in the audience—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san's daikon candy worked like a 
charm, didn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hoho. Your feng shui was just as 
effective, Rickey-chan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Copano Rickey and the others 
succeeded in supporting Hokko Tarumae.
